claims.statement: Independently verify the global first-pair supremum and infimum proof on bounded positive weights (including measurable, step and piecewise continuous classes), and the resulting candidate formulas. Check existence, first variations, bang-bang reduction, quotient monotonicity, energy identity, interface symmetry and phase balance; candidate attainment alone is insufficient.

Independently verify the MW reproof and its use in the ratio theorem: affine scaling, signed cell matching, zero truncation including common zeros, parameter motion, density extension and exact scope of adjacent-index upper bound. Find unresolved mathematical gaps rather than accepting historical claims.
